title: crepis virens subsp. agrestis
intro: Crepis virens subsp. agrestis, commonly known as Field Hawk's-bit, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating digestive issues and inflammation due to its ability to soothe the gut and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Crepis virens subsp. agrestis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
